comment: 'Degrade gracefully rather than exclude' is asserted as a structural property but is nowhere testable: no component profile states what its degraded-mode behaviour is, and the conformance section (4.3.5) does not test for it. An untestable equity principle will be designed out in implementation, and the settings least well served — the draft's own phrase — will be excluded by conformance requirements rather than by intent.

public.text: 'Degrade gracefully rather than exclude' is asserted as a structural property but is nowhere testable: no component profile states what its degraded-mode behaviour is, and the conformance section (4.3.5) does not test for it. An untestable equity principle will be designed out in implementation, and the settings least well served — the draft's own phrase — will be excluded by conformance requirements rather than by intent.
public.suggestedRevision: Require each component profile to declare degraded-mode behaviour (what functions persist under intermittent connectivity, absent national ID, or partial registry coverage) and include degraded-mode operation in the conformance and testing framework of 4.3.5.
